scope: Independent appearance comparison of supplied renders against three actually viewed product images; no geometry, new render, topology/normals test or manifest change.

images_actually_compared.rights: Private documentary reference only; no photo pixels used as textures.

comparability_limits: The candidate is assembled with bolts; the product photographs show separated upper/lower halves without those four installed bolt heads. Clamping gap, final preload and visible hardware stack cannot be matched directly.
Different oblique cameras, rotation, framing, lighting, exposure and backgrounds. No shared camera calibration, scale target, roughness measurement or colour reference.
Matriz is the useful detailed surface/form source. POW views are only260x260 including packaging; they corroborate general shape and lower stud but cannot resolve micrograin or small radii.
36DS1801 seller identification remains a related-market/variant reference, not certified exact current RDC fitment. A similarity does not close mounting or dimensional unknowns.
The present review is of the exact preview hashes only; it does not transfer to any later changed model or render.

observations.topic: main silhouette and open tube seat
observations.finding: The candidate preserves upper/lower profiled saddles, raised crown, two lateral bolt ears, an open round tube passage and lower central stud. The images do not support calling it a rectangular solid or a filled tube passage.
observations.action: No obligatory shape change inferred from these unmatched views.

observations.finding: Matriz shows broad curved outer highlights and rounded transitions; the candidate has a continuous arch and rounded crown/ear transition. Apparent transverse bulging differs, but Matriz rotates and separates the halves while the render shows an assembled part.
observations.action: Do not order a new convexity, thickness or silhouette deformation from highlight shape alone.

observations.finding: Candidate ears and exposed front faces read rather regular; Matriz edges read softer and locally uneven. The photographs nevertheless do not establish the same section plane or allow a radius/depth comparison.
observations.action: No mandatory radius or ear-width change. Do not copy individual casting/photographic irregularities as certified geometry.

observations.finding: In preview-detail the small irregular relief is conspicuous on the outer crown, front cut face and visible cylindrical tube seat. On Matriz, the outside has a subtle casting-like texture while the concave tube seat reads smoother, with a more continuous dark reflection. The render therefore separates those surface finishes less clearly than the detailed source photo.
observations.certainty_limit: These images prove a difference in surface reading, not a roughness number, measured grain size, machining process or exact surface finish on the RDC bike. Lighting can amplify the difference.
observations.action: Convey to maker A: reduce the visible granular relief on the tube-contact seat relative to the cast exterior; retain a restrained exterior texture. Check appearance through the existing material workflow. No geometry or new scratch texture is required by this observation.

observations.finding: The isolated lower saddle in Matriz exposes a small circular depression on the concave seat. In the assembled candidate, the corresponding inner surface is partially occluded and dark; this view does not demonstrate either its absence or a wrong position.
observations.action: Do not order another hole or deepen the existing feature from this view. Reference-observations already records the function/size uncertainty.

observations.topic: joint gap, visible bores and stud
observations.finding: The candidate has a thin dark separation between the halves and a lower threaded stud. Product photos confirm separated halves with two passages and one lower stud, but do not show the same assembled preload or the installed upper bolts.
observations.action: No request to close the gap, shorten the stud, change bolt heads or alter stack height from these photos.

observations.finding: Both candidate and detailed source read as light silver metal. Candidate bolts/stud have brighter narrow highlights than the product sample; the studio render and uncontrolled product lighting are too different to identify a material error from that alone.
observations.action: Do not prescribe a new albedo, metalness or corrosion layer from brightness alone.

certain_findings_to_maker_A: PHOTO-CLAMP-04: material surface reading inside the tube seat is more granular and less differentiated from the outer casting than in the detailed Matriz photograph; act on surface response, without inventing new geometry.

decision.conclusion: No additional silhouette/void/section correction is sufficiently demonstrated by the supplied unmatched views. One supported material-reading difference is passed to maker A. Dimensional fit, transverse crown recovery, exact RDC finish and user artistic acceptance remain open.
